g.title: PocketRealm
g.text: Pocket Realm connected-mode MVP: authority, durability, and trust boundaries

g.title: cluster_active_host
g.text: Current simulation-authority phone (one whole realm for MVP)

g.title: cluster_consensus
g.text: Canonical-history trust boundary: fixed voters, not every transient phone

g.title: cluster_infra
g.text: Replaceable infrastructure — explicitly not an owner of realm history

g.title: backup
g.text: durability only; cannot elect or simulate

g.title: policy
g.text: A write is canonical only after a quorum commits it.
Every sink rejects stale authority epochs.
No quorum ⇒ no new shared-value success.
